story:
Ethan loved dinosaurs, especially the roaring T-Rex. Today in class, Ms. Lily announced a special "Dinosaur Habitat Project.[emotion:QT/happy] " "You will build a home for a toy dinosaur!" she said, holding up a small plastic Triceratops. Ethan thought about his own toy T-Rex. He really wanted to build a big, green jungle for it. [emotion:QT/calm] He imagined tall, spiky trees and a winding river.

Ms. Lily told everyone to find their materials. [emotion:QT/afraid] Ethan felt a little nervous because he needed green construction paper and fuzzy pipe cleaners, but he couldn't see them anywhere in the craft bin. He looked *under* the table and *behind* the pile of blue paper. [emotion:QT/sad] "Where did they go?" he whispered. [emotion:QT/angry] He felt quite frustrated because he wanted to start making the tall jungle trees.
Maya, a girl with bright red shoes, was working *next to* him. She noticed Ethan's frown. [emotion:QT/calm] "Are you okay, Ethan?" she asked, her voice gentle. "I can't find green paper," Ethan said, pointing vaguely. "And the long, bendy sticks.[gesture:think] " Maya thought for a moment. "Oh, you mean the pipe cleaners! They are usually *above* the scissors, in the clear box," she said, pointing to a shelf. [gesture:nodding-yes] "And the green paper is often *under* the yellow stack.[emotion:QT/happy] "
Ethan felt relieved when Maya helped him find the supplies. "Thank you," he said. [emotion:QT/happy] Maya smiled. "We can *share* the green paper if you want, so that we both have enough," she offered. "We can also *take turns* adding things to our habitats.[emotion:QT/happy] "

Ethan and Maya began to work together. Maya showed Ethan how to twist the pipe cleaners into jungle vines. Ethan carefully glued the green paper leaves onto cardboard tubes to make tall trees. [emotion:QT/happy] They were both so *curious* about how their habitats would look. They talked about where the T-Rex might hide and what plants it would eat. [emotion:QT/happy] When Ms. Lily came by, she smiled. "What a wonderful, leafy jungle you two made!" she exclaimed. [emotion:QT/happy] Ethan felt so proud of their work, especially because he and Maya had built it together. [emotion:QT/happy] He realized that *asking for help* had made the project much easier and more fun.

questions.question: Why was it a good idea for Ethan to ask Maya for help when he couldn't find his supplies?
questions.correct_answer: Asking for help makes difficult tasks easier.
wrong_answers: It's important to always try to solve problems on your own first.
You should always know where all your craft supplies are kept.

questions.question: What is one lesson from Ethan and Maya building their dinosaur habitat together?
questions.correct_answer: Working together with friends helps everyone succeed.
wrong_answers: It's important to have a clear plan before you start building.
You should always make sure your project looks exactly how you imagined.

questions.question: What did Maya show us when she offered to share her green paper and take turns?
questions.correct_answer: Sharing materials and taking turns is a kind way to collaborate.
wrong_answers: It's important to keep your own materials separate from others.
You should always finish your own part of the project first.
